{"consolidated_memory":"## Duplicate Charge in Stripe Webhook Consumer - Eight Separate Incidents

**Component:** billing/webhooks/stripe.py (Python, billing side)

**Recurring Problem Signature:** Duplicate charges in webhook consumer, manifesting as two ledger rows sharing one event id

**Consistent Repro Method:** Redeliver the same webhook id twice

**Test Coverage:** tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py

---

### Incident 1: Timezone Awareness Mismatch [2026-02-19]
- **Triggered By:** Accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- **Root Cause:** Naive datetime compared against aware datetime
- **Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #1384, branch fix/duplicate-charge-1)
- **Outcome:** Alert stayed quiet for 33 consecutive days

### Incident 2: Off-by-One Slice Bound [2026-03-14]
- **Triggered By:** Two requests raced on the same key
- **Root Cause:** Off-by-one error in slice bound
- **Fix:** Corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #2009, branch fix/duplicate-charge-2)
- **Outcome:** Reclaimed 83 GB of blob storage

### Incident 3: Floating Point Rounding in Money Path [2026-05-04]
- **Triggered By:** Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** Moved arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #2288, branch fix/duplicate-charge-3)
- **Outcome:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 31 days running

### Incident 4: Unbounded Retry Loop [2026-05-21]
- **Triggered By:** Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root Cause:** Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix:** Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #3804, branch fix/duplicate-charge-4)
- **Outcome:** Memory settled at 607 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB

### Incident 5: Missing Unicode Normalisation [2026-05-26]
- **Triggered By:** Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Root Cause:** Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix:** Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #5017, branch fix/duplicate-charge-5)
- **Outcome:** Job finished in 70 minutes instead of 6 hours

### Incident 6: Missing Composite Index [2026-06-17]
- **Triggered By:** After the client had already retried once
- **Root Cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #5868, branch fix/duplicate-charge-6)
- **Outcome:** Cold start dropped 84 percent, to 404 ms

### Incident 7: Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields [2026-07-01]
- **Triggered By:** Clients pinned to v1 SDK
- **Root Cause:** Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Fix:** Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #6009, branch fix/duplicate-charge-7)
- **Outcome:** 54 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

### Incident 8: Race in Lazy Initialisation [2026-08-26]
- **Triggered By:** Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root Cause:** Race condition in lazy initialisation
- **Fix:** Guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #9975, branch fix/duplicate-charge-8)
- **Outcome:** Flaky test went from 85 failures per hundred runs to zero"}
